description: A modern armchair with a striking, boxy silhouette. The seat and high back are upholstered in a light grey, textured fabric, offering a comfortable and inviting appearance. The chair rests on a distinctive X-shaped base made of polished metal, providing a sleek and contemporary contrast to the soft upholstery. The clean lines and geometric design suggest a piece of furniture that is both functional and visually appealing, likely serving as a statement piece in a well-designed interior space.
